info.title: Tahweel API
info.description: Self-hosted mobile-wallet SMS payment confirmation. Three credentials: the listener phone uses `Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN>` on `/ingest/*`, integrators use `X-Api-Key: <API_KEY>` on `/api/v1/*`, and the dashboard exchanges `ADMIN_PASSWORD` for a JWT used as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on `/admin/*`.

note.description: For held messages, the reason: balance_mismatch, no_balance, no_balance_history or above_review_limit

expected_balance_cents.description: Last confirmed balance plus this amount, when known

reviewed_at.description: When an operator approved or manually matched the message

BalanceVerification.description: verified: the balance equals the last confirmed balance plus the amount, within the balance margin. mismatch: it does not. no_balance: the SMS carries no balance. no_history: there is no confirmed balance yet to compare with.

reference.description: The integrator's own id for this payment. Unique.

amount.description: Expected amount in major units (e.g. 200 = 200.00 EGP)

sender_phone.description: The phone the customer will pay from. Strongly recommended.

allow_amount_only.description: RISKY: without sender_phone, match on an exact amount alone (only when exactly one such intent is pending).

verify_balance.description: Hold receipts whose wallet balance cannot be confirmed

balance_margin.description: Allowed difference between the expected and the stated balance, in major units

review_above_amount.description: Hold receipts above this amount (major units) for review; null turns it off

phone_filter.description: Tell listener phones to forward only trusted senders and money-looking SMS

webhook_url.description: Default target for events; null when neither the setting nor WEBHOOK_URL is set

webhook_secret_set.description: Whether an HMAC secret is available (the secret itself is never returned)

webhook_url.description: null falls back to WEBHOOK_URL from the environment

webhook_secret.description: Write-only; null falls back to WEBHOOK_SECRET from the environment

post.summary: Forward a batch of SMS from the listener phone
post.description: Idempotent. The phone forwards every SMS; the server classifies each one (receipt or not, trusted sender, age) and tries to match receipts to pending payment intents. Duplicate fingerprints are accepted but not re-inserted.
Sent every 60 s by the listener. Missing heartbeats past the offline threshold raise a device.offline event. The response carries the forwarding rules the phone applies to new SMS.

Tell Tahweel that you expect a wallet transfer. Matching requires sender_phone (recommended) or allow_amount_only=true (risky). If a matching receipt already arrived it is matched immediately and the response carries status=matched.
